one_line: Maharaja of Travancore and captured Dutch officer whose defection reshaped the Dutch–Travancore War and the Battle of Colachel (1741).

appearance.age_look: Marthanda Varma appears late 20s with a lean, athletic build; De Lannoy appears early 30s with a taller, broad-shouldered soldier’s frame.
appearance.face: Marthanda Varma has an oval face, medium-brown Kerala complexion, straight brows, sharp nose, strong jaw, and calm, calculating eyes with a faint confident smile; De Lannoy has a long face, light European complexion, prominent nose, trimmed moustache, and serious, slightly guarded gaze.
appearance.hair: Marthanda Varma’s hair is long, black and oiled, drawn into a high Kerala-style knot under a narrow gold cloth turban band with a small central gem; De Lannoy has shoulder-length wavy ash-brown hair tied back with a dark blue ribbon, no hat.
appearance.costume: Marthanda Varma wears a long off-white cotton angavastram wrapped tightly as a dhoti to the ankles with a deep maroon border, paired with a matching maroon long-sleeved upper cloth (similar to an early angarkha) crossing at the chest and tied at the waist, a gold waistbelt (uddiyana) with a central oval buckle, multiple medium-width gold chains and a single tulunadan-style necklace, gold bangles, and plain leather sandals; De Lannoy wears a dark navy-blue knee-length Dutch officer’s coat with slightly flared skirts, narrow standing collar, and muted brass buttons, over a pale cream waistcoat and white cotton shirt with simple collar, dark tan knee-breeches, off-white stockings, and brown leather shoes with small brass buckles, plus a plain brown leather crossbelt and belt with minimal brass fittings, suggesting stripped-down campaign gear.
appearance.signature: Marthanda Varma carries a slightly curved steel sword with a simple brass hilt and wooden scabbard held in his left hand, while De Lannoy carries a long flintlock musket with a brown wooden stock and iron barrel resting upright at his side.

ref_desc: Marthanda Varma is a medium-brown, sharp-eyed Kerala ruler in maroon upper cloth, off-white dhoti with maroon border, gold belt and jewellery, black hair in a high knot with a gold band, holding a curved sword, beside De Lannoy, a light-complexioned, ash-brown-haired Dutch officer in a navy coat, cream waistcoat, tan breeches, and brown leather gear holding a flintlock musket.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of two fixed characters standing side by side: on the left Marthanda Varma, a medium-brown–skinned young Kerala king with an oval face, sharp nose and calm, confident eyes, his long black hair oiled and tied into a high knot encircled by a narrow gold cloth turban band with a tiny central gem, wearing an off-white cotton dhoti wrapped neatly to the ankles with a deep maroon border, a deep maroon long-sleeved upper cloth crossing at the chest and tied at the waist, a gold waistbelt with an oval buckle, layered medium-width gold chains and a single tulunadan-style necklace, gold bangles, and plain leather sandals, holding in his left hand a slightly curved steel sword with a simple brass hilt and wooden scabbard; on the right Eustachius De Lannoy, a tall, broad-shouldered light-complexioned European officer with a long face, wavy ash-brown hair tied back with a dark blue ribbon, trimmed moustache and serious eyes, dressed in a dark navy-blue knee-length Dutch officer’s coat with muted brass buttons and flared skirts, over a pale cream waistcoat and white shirt, with dark tan knee-breeches, off-white stockings, brown leather shoes with small brass buckles, and a plain brown leather crossbelt and belt, holding a long flintlock musket with a brown wooden stock and iron barrel resting upright at his side; keep colours consistent—maroon and off-white for Marthanda Varma, navy blue, cream, tan and brown leather for De Lannoy—with clean, era-accurate tailoring and modest, fully clothed designs presented clearly from head to toe on a neutral background.
